published_record_investigations.title: Konrad Adenauer Foundation Scholarship

findings.proposal: Up to EUR 992/month Bachelor's/Master's, up to EUR 1,400/month doctoral; tuition reimbursement exceptional up to EUR 750/semester, not universal full tuition.
Primarily international non-EU applicants meeting in-country/participating-office route; not ALL unrestricted.
German B2 required even for English-taught degrees; no universal IELTS/TOEFL/SAT minimum documented.
Domestic selection July 15 annually at 12:00 CET per official page; overseas office deadlines differ. Next domestic July 15 2027 subject to programme continuing.
Bachelor from 2nd semester, qualifying 4-semester Master's, and PhD; not medicine/dentistry state exam or short programmes.

published_record_investigations.action: likely duplicate aliases of one international scholarship; confirm canonical identity before authorized archive
